name: Dorman Products, Inc.
summary: Dorman Products, Inc. supplies replacement and upgrade parts for the motor vehicle aftermarket industry in the United States and internationally. It operates through segments Light Duty, Heavy Duty, and Specialty Vehicle segments. The company offers engine products, including intake and exhaust manifolds, oil filters and coolers, fans, thermostat housings, and throttle bodies; undercar products, such as fluid lines, fluid reservoirs, connectors, 4-wheel drive components and axles, drain plugs, other engine, transmission, and axle components; steering and suspension products comprising control arms, ball joints, tie-rod ends, brake hardware and hydraulics, wheel and axle hardware, suspension …
